purpose: Results this repository has confirmed hold wrong content. An entry withdraws a result from current delivery. It does not delete it, re-sign it, or relabel it as a structural non-applicability: the original Run stays readable so the defect can be demonstrated and the repair checked.

defects.summary: 26 of 58 excerpts are executive-officer biography from the Form 10-K unnumbered Part I item, labelled EXPLICIT_LEGAL_SECTION_TEXT because ITEM_3 ran past that item to ITEM 5.
defects.repair: scripts/vnext/historical_text_results.py closes a numbered item at the form's unnumbered Part I item

defects.summary: Item 3 incorporates Note 16A by reference. The sub-note is located: Note 16 carries 'A. Legal Proceedings' with B (guarantees), C (commitments), D (contingent consideration) and E (insurance) after it, and the scope runs from A to B. Correctly scoped, the excerpt set is 92 items and 41,860 rendered characters - 65 percent of max_text_chars and 144 percent of max_items - so what stops this coordinate is the item count, not the scope and not the volume.
defects.repair: scripts/vnext/historical_text_results.incorporated_scopes locates the lettered sub-note. Raising the item bound needs two layers, not one. Layer 1 (what a Spec may declare) is done: catalog/r6/D02_legal_disclosures_v2.md declares 192 and scripts/vnext/historical_spec_revision.py compiles it without changing specs.py. Layer 2 (what the ORDERED_NEWLINE_V1 protocol will render) is open and is the reason the route still points at v1.

open_decision.question: whether this generation carries a successor text-result protocol so a result of more than 64 excerpts can be rendered at all
open_decision.why_it_is_not_an_implementation_choice: 64 is a literal in text_results.render_text_payload, a new_rule_file of issue_28_v11 checked on both roots and in fourteen generations' execution authority. A successor would duplicate about 155 lines across five functions, two of which - validate_text_record and verify_text_trace - are the integrity checks on a text result, and would grow the registration patch from 3 files and 9 hunks to about 6 files and 14 hunks.

options.action: carry a successor text-result protocol in this generation
options.cost: about 155 duplicated lines including two integrity checks; patch 3->6 files

options.action: leave the bound at 64 and record this coordinate as refused by the protocol, with the measurement
options.cost: Pfizer D02 produces no result in any year whose filing exceeds 64 excerpts

open_decision.recommendation: B unless this coordinate must be delivered in this PR
not_done: merging adjacent excerpts so the count fits, which trades one observation per source block for a smaller number
narrowing the scope so the count fits
